svg.title: The 8 bosses (I am the maintenance staff)
svg.desc: Eight cute cats in two rows of four: Rubio tuxedo, Rubia, Rubio tuxedo peludo, Rubia tuxedo, Calico 1, Calico 2, Calico gorda, and Carey. Eyes blink, tails swish, and bodies breathe on staggered timers.
svg.text: The 8 bosses (I am the maintenance staff)
